description: Pass/fail from a data replay. No model judgment belongs in this record.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the replay, in milliseconds.
duration_ms.title: Duration Ms

failures_remaining.description: Contract failures still present after the patch. Must be 0 when passed is true and greater than 0 when passed is false.
failures_remaining.title: Failures Remaining

passed.description: True only when failures_remaining is 0. False only when failures_remaining is greater than 0.
passed.title: Passed

rows_checked.description: Number of rows the verifier replayed.
rows_checked.title: Rows Checked

title: VerificationResult
